overview.text: Mike Gipson is a Democratic member of the California State Assembly. He has represented the 65th District since 2022 and represented the 64th District from 2014 to 2022. He sits on the Assembly Revenue and Taxation Committee. He previously served on the Carson City Council and as chief of staff to a former Board of Equalization chair. Gipson says he will close corporate tax loopholes and increase large business audits. He plans to reduce taxes on working families and small businesses. He wants to standardize property tax assessments by establishing a committee to study county best practices. In 2023, he coauthored a proposed constitutional amendment to restore parent-child home transfers without property reassessment. In 2026, he authored Assembly Bill 1795 requiring insurers to follow new standards for wildfire smoke damage.
